people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by his arms; but they didn’t know that I healed them.
translations.bsb: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms, but they never realized that it was I who healed them.
translations.kjv: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed
